notes: The manifest is durable runtime configuration. The stable server only interprets route/source/style/script metadata; all page-owned code remains on runtime. /collector serves the Frozen Web Snapshot Collector control room directly from runtime, allowing compatible page and collector-engine revisions without Vercel redeployment. Ice Dragon now uses a versioned v13 asset hydrator that normalizes browser-loaded base64 before decoding, logs normalization lengths, and collapses concurrent boot triggers onto single in-flight companion/adult/overall hydration promises. The theme log viewer remains available with copy, export, and clear controls.
